---
name: "💡 Tip / Document Drop"
about: Point the ledger at something it should capture, verify, or fingerprint.
title: "[TIP] "
labels: [tip]
---

**What should the ledger look at?** (page, PDF, meeting, quote, check number…)

**Where does it live?** (URL or "I have the file")

**When did it happen / when was it published?**

**Why does it matter?** (one or two sentences — what would it prove?)

**Proof you can share:** paste a verbatim quote, a screenshot hash
(`sha256sum file.pdf`), or a meeting + timestamp. Verbatim beats paraphrase.

> Tips are inputs for a human reviewer. The machine does not send letters,
> file complaints, or contact officials on its own.
